text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“—Ah, mic check, mic check... Good 
afternoon, good evening, or perhaps good 
morning.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Today's Mar-chan: Vodka was taking photos 
of a motorbike, so I hopped into the shot 
with her. She told me all about how 
amazing the bike is."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Also, I tried to photobomb Scarlet's 
selfie and got caught. But she said, 
"Let's just take one together normally."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Did I manage to leave a lasting impression 
in everyone's memories today, too? I sure 
hope so. —That is all. End of recording.
